decisions.statement: Every body a landing landed is named in the report.
A body that landed differently from the body handed in is named in the report.
A landing given no commit message is said as the act and the paths that landing has.
The paths in such a message are sorted.
A landing with more than three paths is said as the act and how many paths landed.
A repair a landing ran to put things back answers with what that repair said.
A repair that went through says nothing.
An index left naming what did not land says how to build the index again.
A landing that committed is said as the commit that landing made.
A landing that committed nothing says which of the two reasons it was.
A tree already holding what was asked for is one reason.
Paths the repository ignores being taken away is the other.
A landing that took such a path away names every path it took, sorted.

definition: the report a landing answers with
